cards.title: One agent hands a task to another
cards.text: A router picks the tools and the role, a specialist works with only those, and the user watches the work.

cards.title: A router and its specialists
cards.text: Puls's prompt shrank from ~28,600 tokens to ~2,200; each specialist carries only its own tools.

cards.title: What delegation cost
cards.text: The same ten questions to one agent and to Puls, both priced from the usage ledger.

cards.title: A triage team
cards.text: Sorter, manager, investigator, coder and reviewer, each ending its turn with a typed call.

cards.title: One address for every call
cards.text: AskAgent("puls.cook"): the role is part of the address, and Calls says whom an identity may ask.

cards.title: Minions
cards.text: A level-2 session for one task, with one of its asker's tools, never kept.
